description: Spectral Instruments optical cameras deployed on the Las Cumbres Observatory 2.0-meter Faulkes Telescopes (FTN and FTS), providing optical imaging in Johnson-Cousins, SDSS, and Pan-STARRS filters.
facility_description: Las Cumbres Observatory (LCO) operates twin 2.0-meter Faulkes Telescopes at Haleakala Observatory (FTN) and Siding Spring Observatory (FTS).
notes: Curves are LCO filter transmission scans (lco_filter_curves.zip). The LCO Spectral page says the Spectral camera on Faulkes Telescope North has been permanently replaced by MuSCAT3.
